id: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (2009)

facts.text: Take a seat, Harry. Talent like yours deserves a good dinner. Bring a friend, if you like.
facts.why: Invented. Slughorn's real line about Harry is 'Anyone who aspires to be anyone ends up here. But then again, you already are someone, aren't you, Harry?'
facts.fix: Take a seat, Harry. Anyone who aspires to be anyone ends up at my table. Bring a friend.

fix_note.text: Take a seat, Harry. Anyone who aspires to be anyone ends up at my table. Bring a friend.

facts.text: the trolley on the Hogwarts Express
facts.why: The transcript has Harry and Luna on the train after Malfoy's attack, but no trolley scene. The note now says only that.
facts.fix: the Hogwarts Express, where Harry ends up with Luna

vibe.verdict: Slughorn's Slug Club is a good setting and the pineapple and mead nods are sharp.
